name: VC Outreach Drafts
description: Turn reviewed lead rows into Claude-written email and LinkedIn drafts. Two independent channels per lead: email first touch + 5-day follow-up, and LinkedIn connect + DM. No sending.

inputs.label: Lead data
inputs.placeholder: Paste rows from the VC Lead Finder CSV, including the header row.

inputs.label: Campaign context
inputs.placeholder: What is this campaign about? Who are you reaching out to and why should they care?

inputs.label: Sender context
inputs.placeholder: Who are you and why are you reaching out? 2-3 sentences. Claude will use this to frame the tone and credibility.

inputs.label: Outreach goal
inputs.placeholder: What do you want from each recipient? Be specific about what a successful reply looks like.

inputs.label: Call to action
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Would you be open to a 20-minute call to compare notes?
